description: This Java source file defines the FormEditor class, which extends OpenmrsPropertyEditor to serialize and deserialize Form objects in the OpenMRS framework. It provides methods to retrieve Form objects by ID and UUID.

classes.name: FormEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for serializing and deserializing Form objects within the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a Form object by its ID using the FormService.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Form object by its UUID using the FormService.
